visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman sits at a white kitchen island in a modern, well-lit home environment. She is dressed in a pink tank top and purple shorts, calmly eating a large lettuce-wrapped burger or sandwich. Her facial expression is focused on her meal as she takes bites. (2) A man wearing a black tank top enters the scene from the background. He walks toward the island and reaches out both hands to grab the plastic food container sitting in front of the woman. His movement is quick and unexpected. (3) The woman immediately reacts by lunging forward, grabbing the food with both hands, and shoving a large portion into her mouth. She turns her body away from the man defensively while chewing vigorously. The man pulls back his hands and stares at her with a confused, blank expression. (4) Still chewing rapidly, the woman gathers her phone and the remaining food from the container. She keeps her eyes on the man briefly before standing up from her barstool and walking away, leaving him standing alone by the island.
